one_liner: Every launch opens with a 90-180 s batch window: all buys clear at one uniform price, pro-rata with per-wallet caps; curve opens after. Kills first-second bundling.
First N minutes after open: only Dojang-attested wallets may buy, capped per wallet (Upbit attester > faucet attester).
Graduation needs quote threshold AND >= N distinct attested buyers; single-whale instant graduation impossible.
Immutable on-chain manifest hash (allowlist <= 5 public wallets, creator allocation, fees, vesting) shown before first buy; no hidden exemptions.

idea: Per-block uniform pricing on the curve
one_liner: All buys within one 1-s block settle at the block-start price with a per-block fill cap; intra-block ordering yields nothing.
Use pending-tag quotes and 200 ms preconfs for instant fill feedback and accurate slippage; expose flashblock index in trade feed.
Creator schedules open time (KST prime time); countdown page; pre-registration with Dojang; no trading before T0.
Unverified wallets: 1 launch/day; attested: 3/day; high reputation: 10/day; deposit refunded on >= 10 distinct buyers.
Creator posts a small bond returned when the token reaches >= 10 distinct buyers or graduates; forfeited bonds fund holder rewards.
Classic curve / Batch-first / Dojang-gated / Squad launch selectable; mode shown as badge; A/B rotate default per week on testnet.
Creator opening buy goes to a vesting vault: cliff at graduation, linear 30 days after; creator cannot sell on the curve.
Fees accrue inside curve/pool and are claimable any time by the creator or pushed by anyone (bounty); no keeper dependency.
Score from graduations with distinct buyers, holder retention, no-dump history + Dojang/UP ID; gates limits and featured slots; issued as our own EAS attestation.
Milestones (holders, age, volume quality) unlock vesting tranches, badge upgrades and reward boosts; lifecycle instead of graduate-and-forget.

idea: Creator studio with AI meme kit
one_liner: Bilingual description/translation, image safety check, auto OG/share cards for KakaoTalk/Telegram/X.
Consecutive weekly launches that hit quality thresholds earn fee-share boosts; broken by dumps.
2-5 creators launch together with split fee rights and shared vesting; squad page.
Trending ranks by distinct attested buyers, holder growth and retention; churn-detected tokens demoted; 'fresh humans' badge.
On-chain heuristics (sell-back ratio, same-funder clusters, same-block bursts) label tokens and wallets; shown on cards.
Before buy: shows manifest, creator vesting, top-holder share, attested-buyer count, churn flags; one glance risk read.
Our locked pool charges 1%; 30% of it streams to holders by time-weighted balance (claimable), 40% creator, 30% protocol.
Curve sells route through the batch window when a block's sell pressure exceeds X% so dumps clear at uniform price.
Per-wallet realised/unrealised P&L, holding time, 'you were buyer #12 of 60' narrative.
Alerts on graduation, chapter unlocks, creator actions; Korean templates.
Pool LP is minted to a non-upgradeable burner with public proof page; no admin path.
All parameter changes via Safe + 48 h timelock; pending changes rendered in the app.
Separate live indicators; trading stays possible from chain reads when indexer lags.
Graduation, fee pushes, chapter checks callable by anyone for a bounty; our bots are just first in line.

idea: Verified creator via Dojang + UP ID
one_liner: Badge requires Upbit-attested wallet (or faucet attester on testnet) and a UP ID name; shown everywhere.
Later: allocations capped by attested exchange balance tiers (small holders get priority windows).
Form squads; fee-share routed to squad treasury; squad leaderboards by quality score.
Squad vs squad: most graduations with >= 25 attested buyers in a week; prizes in season points.
4-week seasons with themes (Chuseok, K-pop comebacks, exams) and themed badges.
KO default with EN toggle, Korean number formats (만/억), KST times, Kakao share.
Verified streamer launches with on-stream batch window; stream embed on token page.

idea: Soulbound season credit as curve quote
one_liner: Rationed non-transferable credit minted daily per wallet (Dojang-weighted) is the only curve quote on testnet; introduces scarcity.
Points for distinct counterparties, holding time, curation accuracy, creator retention; zero for volume/tx count.
First 100 attested buyers of a token that graduates share a pool fee slice for 30 days.
Scores finalised 7 days after season end; detected sybil clusters are zeroed; public method.
Referral credit only when referee reaches 5 distinct counterparties and 7-day retention.
Human/AI tags (animal, K-pop, finance, politics-safe); feed per narrative; Korean tag synonyms.
Token page shows 'you would be attested buyer #13 of 25 needed to graduate'.
Prices in ETH, USD and KRW (Pyth ETH/USD + KRW/USD).
Season NFTs (soulbound) carry reputation and badges to mainnet; no token promise.
